entities.summary: The Republic of China Army also known as the ROC Army (ROCA); colloquially the Taiwanese Army by western or mainland Chinese media, or commonly referred as the National Military by local Taiwanese people, is the largest branch of Taiwan's military, the Republic of China Armed Forces.
